item.title: Looking to buy a business in Canada? Here’s what to do, and how we help.
item.description: Buying an established business can be the fastest way into the Canadian market. Here’s what you need to prepare, the rules to know, and what we do for you at every step.

item.title: The Middle East is set to rebound. Expansion and investment are the way forward.
item.description: After a difficult year, forecasters expect a sharp recovery for Gulf economies in 2027. The companies that diversify their markets now will be best placed when it comes.

item.title: Nigerian companies: it’s time to look at Canada and the US
item.description: Nigeria is now Canada’s second-largest trading partner in Africa, and duty-free access to the US has been renewed. Here’s why North America belongs in your plan, and how we help you get there.
